content:
```yamlfile
name: Test Linux x86_64 (2/6)
on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'release-*'
  merge_group:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'release-*'
  workflow_dispatch:

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}2
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test Linux x86_64 (2/6)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      QEMU_BUILD_VERSION: 10.0.3
      SDE_BUILD_VERSION: 9.58.0-2025-06-16
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
      - uses: ./.github/actions/install-rust
      - run: rustup target add wasm32-wasip1 wasm32-unknown-unknown
      - run: cargo fetch --locked
      - name: CPU information
        run: lscpu
      - run: python3 ./ci/run-tests.py --locked
```
